summary.name: Patterns
summary.one_liner: Patterns is a regular expression editor app from KrillApps that shows live matches, replacements, and syntax highlighting while you write a pattern.
use_cases: Testing and debugging a regular expression before using it in code
Previewing search and replace results with a regex
Exporting a regex to code in different programming languages
Learning regex syntax with a built-in quick reference
Checking regex compatibility across flavors such as PCRE, Java, or Ruby
summary.what_it_does: Patterns lets you enter a regular expression and see matches, captured groups, and replacements update in real time as you edit. Syntax highlighting shows how the regex engine interprets each part of the pattern. Clicking a match or group highlights both the matched text and the regex portion that produced it. A Copy Code feature exports the pattern for several programming languages, and a built-in quick reference sheet covers regex syntax. It also reports the nature of syntax errors in the pattern.
notable: Supports many regex flavors: Oniguruma, POSIX BRE and ERE, Perl (PCRE), emacs, Java, Ruby, bash, grep, and sed
Clicking a match or group highlights the corresponding part of the regex that produced it
Copy Code exports patterns for multiple programming languages
